views.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 original FRONT Byzantine militia javelineer, Image2/3 his side/back. Preserve exact original grey brown patched quilted coat/trousers cloth cap, dark beard, purple sash, back javelin bundle, leather pouches, legwraps/boots. Militia BARE HANDS no gloves no armor upgrade. Preserve original weapon/shield designs incl pointed iron tip and round shield boss. Same neutral grey softly lit background, realistic game concept style.
